test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9506ccdeaf046aad5a62f266dfd274c61603e2c17154753a7c31859266e2eabf.png]
solution:
We compare figures 1 and 3:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b9e03f68441a16451c4c5230d0b223d62b6dd4f22483f96369ae534081d9d13.png] 

When the faces '6' and '5' are visible in both the cases, we get '3' on the left and '4' on the right.

So, **'3' is the face opposite '4'.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
